take: Dallas announced it has placed center Oskar Back on long-term injured reserve and defenseman Esa Lindell on injured reserve. Back, a fourth-line forward at 11:18 a night, has been out three games, and Joel Kiviranta has taken his spot beside Faksa and Blackwell. Lindell's absence is bigger: Thomas Harley has moved in beside Miro Heiskanen, who is up to 29:26 a night from 25:01, and Kyle Capobianco has gone from 2:59 to 12:59. Dallas controls 54% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) this season, so the group has been holding up.
